name: directus-extension-image-url-preview
description: Directus interface: shows a text field's value as an image preview on the record's Detail/Edit page, read-only - the value itself is system-written (crawler/promotion pipeline), never hand-typed by an editor. Companion to the image-url display (same value/URL-prefix rendering, but for the edit form rather than list/detail table cells, which Displays never reach).
